notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador API, the standard library, and adapter-supplied application FOM, standard MIM, provider package, endpoint, and callback configuration. It sends the standard federate-level HLAsetSwitches interaction with HLAexceptionReporting true and false, verifies the target's public Exception Reporting getter, confirms that a second joined federate remains unchanged, and checks neighboring target switches. It does not test HLAreportMOMexception delivery or rely on provider-specific names, registries, headers, or internal switch state.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador standard-MIM interaction and parameter lookup, receive-order sendInteraction, Exception Reporting and neighboring switch queries, and federation lifecycle
